card.name: Group nouns before relative clauses
card.fires_on: The word right after a group of people (patients, astronauts, hunters) where a clause about what that group did or experienced is about to start, most often "who" after "patients".

modes.label: "who" after patients
modes.description: The word "who" following "patients" or "people", introducing a clause about those who developed or experienced something.
modes.example: Most patients<< who>> developed these infections were taking concomitant

modes.label: Group-noun endings
modes.description: The ending "ers" on a group noun like homeschoolers or hunters, or a group noun itself, before a statement about that group.
modes.example: Hunt<<ers>> who do take animals in these areas will

card.writes: It promotes Chinese words about people as a group, such as self, benefit, and fragile, and suppresses words about teaching or supporting others.
card.plain: It fires on a word naming a group of people just before the text says what happened to that group.
